$comment: Root ADR-0280 (ownership) and ADR-0289 (asked as a browser at an adaptive pace, never giving up; it superseded ADR-0281 and ADR-0283). How 법원경매정보 (courtauction.go.kr) is asked and what a block is. The collector (`collect-courtauction-go-kr` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher), the collection rules (collection-domain::court_auction), the Silver load (infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/courtauction_go_kr.py) and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values.

item_search.$comment: 물건 검색 (진행 물건). cortAuctnSrchCondCd 0004601/0004602 and lclDspslGdsLstUsgCd 10000/20000 are the four combinations the site's own search form sends; the codes are stored as given, their meanings are not restated here. A pass is complete only when every combination was read to its last page.

date_window.$comment: Root ADR-0290 §1-§2. Every item-search request carries this bid-date range, fixed for the whole run from its KST start date. Without it the server answers a default range that slides a day every day (2026-10-21: the four conditions held 63,005 rows without dates and 108,306 with this range), so items whose sale date lies past the default look as if they left the list. The Silver load counts a pass as complete only when its requests carried both fields.

sale_result_search.$comment: 매각결과 검색: the same row shape for items whose sale date has passed, with the sale amount.

item_detail.$comment: Root ADR-0290 §7, ADR-0352, ADR-0384, ADR-0289. 물건상세, asked after a list pass that was not cut short, in the same run, on the same session pool and tally as the lists (collection.session; a block renews the session and asks again), paced in pace_group (collection.pace.goods_detail, the photo-heavy group), with the session headers and its own headers (none: measured 2026-11-04, one plain POST answered). Which properties are asked is computed each run (ADR-0352): this run's in-progress list rows against the last read recorded in read_from, never-read first, then what collection.recrawl says is due, soonest sale date first, at most per_run_limit: a safety bound above every in-progress property (37,244 measured 2026-11-11), so the run's deadline, not a count, ends the asking (root ADR-0540 §2; ADR-0384 §2 asked 1,800). As many answers are read at once as the pace group lets fly, each answer's photos stored photos.store_concurrency at a time, and a hash stored earlier in the run is not stored again (a case's properties answer the same photos). Measured 2026-11-10: 1,800 details and 21,283 photos took 2 h 30 min read one answer and one photo at a time. Measured 2026-11-04: HTTP 200 JSON, 3,274,352 bytes in 0.36 s, 11 JPEG photos, 221 KB each decoded. The details are asked until the run's deadline (collection.session.run_time_budget_seconds) less photos.renditions.run_time_budget_seconds, so the ladder step after the Bronze commit still ends inside the run's budget; what is left is due again next run. Each photo (photos.file_field, base64) is decoded, its format sniffed, and stored once under the shared content-addressed media prefix (photos.object_prefix_from, the 공매 store the parcel edge already serves); the Bronze line keeps the response with that value replaced by sha256:<hex>.
item_detail.$commit_every_lines: Root ADR-0540 §2. The run commits its 물건상세 lines a part at a time, each part its own Bronze object (auction-item-detail-partNNNN-<run>.gz), as soon as it fills: on 2026-11-12 the first night that asked every in-progress property held all its lines until one end-of-run commit and was oom-killed at its 1G cap after 2 h 9 min, so nothing of the night landed. A killed run keeps every committed part and the next run's frontier asks only what is left. 10,000 lines ≈ 190 MB of text (19 KB each, measured), held gzipped; a night of the 37,244 in-progress properties is 4 parts, inside silver_load.max_objects (7) per table.

photos.$renditions: 루트 ADR-0427 §7. 그 밤의 Bronze 가 커밋된 뒤(사이트 요청 없음), 그 밤 저장했거나 이미 있던 사진마다 공용 저장소의 표시 사다리(r2-connections.contract.json parcel_media.renditions)를 공매와 같은 media_renditions::ensure_ladders 로 만든다. 이미 사다리 표시가 있으면 HEAD 한 번이다. 상한(계산): 사진 원천 하나 ~4.5 초(ADR-0427 Consequences 의 rav1e 추정) × per_run_limit 1,500 ÷ concurrency 4 ≈ 28 분 ≤ run_time_budget_seconds 1,800. 상세 묻기는 collection.session.run_time_budget_seconds 16,000 초에서 이 1,800 초를 뺀 14,200 초에 멈추므로, 사다리는 그 밤 Bronze 커밋 뒤 이 1,800 초 안이니, 실행 전체가 16,000 초에 Bronze 커밋 시간을 더한 만큼으로 작업 한도 18,000 초 안에 끝난다. 남거나 실패한 사진은 잃지 않는다: media_ladder_backlog 가 Silver 사진 색인에서 가져간다.

collection.$comment: Root ADR-0289/0290 values the collection rules (collection-domain::court_auction), the asking (collection-application::court_auction_asking) and the browser session pool (collection-infrastructure::court_auction_browser) read.

block_signals.$comment: ADR-0289 §3. A block is HTTP 200 with data.ipcheck=false, a redirect, or HTML where JSON belongs; a good answer has status=200 and an object at /data. Checked before any failure so a blocked session is not read as a broken request. A block is never a refusal: the asking waits session.block_waits_seconds, renews the blocked session and asks again, with no bound; nothing is written that stops a later run, and no person clears anything.

session.$comment: ADR-0289 §1-§3. The site blocks cookies, not addresses (2026-10-21: 16 blocks in about 162,000 requests over 73 minutes, every one cleared by a fresh session), so a session is a browser-profile client with its own cookie jar, opened by a GET of opening_path. pool_size sessions take turns. After the n-th block of one request the asking waits block_waits_seconds[n] (the last repeats for ever), renews that session and asks again. A failure that is not a block (network, 5xx, broken JSON) is asked again failure_retries times, waiting failure_wait_seconds and doubling, then recorded as a failed page; the pass is then incomplete. run_time_budget_seconds is the only end of the asking: it stops the run inside its unit's time limit (orchestration/jobs.v1.json per_run_cap.deadline), and what was left is asked again by the next run. A run that got no answer at all fails: that is the no-progress alert, read by the readiness report. headers are what the site's own screen sends with every call; each search adds its own.

change_fields.$comment: ADR-0290 §2. The list-row fields whose change means a case's detail should be re-read; fields outside this set do not count. Validated against real rows when the detail lane lands; this is the state a list row carries.

pace.$comment: ADR-0289 §4. Per endpoint group, the AIMD width: start/min/max requests in flight, widen after increase_after clear and timely answers, divide by decrease_divisor on a block or a response slower than slow_response_millis. Starts from the 2026-10-21 spike (item search is serial on the server; case detail took concurrency; goods detail is photo-heavy).

recrawl.$comment: ADR-0290 §3. A case's detail is due when never read, when its watched row fields changed, on the days around its sale date, or after max_age_days (a backstop). closed_status_codes are the 종국 jinstatCd values; left empty until measured, so until then the backstop and row-change drive re-reads (never under-reads).

pnu_assembly.$comment: ADR-0290 §8. The 19-digit PNU from the goods-detail object: legal-dong code (4 fields) + ledger-kind digit (산 -> 임야 2, else 토지 1) + 본번 + 부번. Prose lots do not assemble. Measured 2026-10-21: assemblable for 98.6% of 매각대상.

code_names.$comment: Root ADR-0540 §5-§6. The site's own names of the codes the served detail carries, as its 공통코드 endpoint gave them (POST `endpoint` with {"intgGrpCdLst": "<system>-<group>,..."}, the call the site's screens make through pgjUtil.getSTGcodeSystemNm), captured on `captured`. The Gold build (court_auction_silver_to_gold.py) puts each code's name beside it; the words on screen are these, not ours. A code the table lacks gets no name (null), and the code is still served.

personal_names.$comment: Root ADR-0540 §4. The free text a Silver table keeps (매각물건명세서 인수되는 권리·지상권 개요·비고·최선순위 설정, 물건 비고, 제시외건물 비고, 감정요항표) sometimes names a person: measured 2026-10-21 on the prototype's 39,296 물건상세, 258 of 4,269 filled 인수되는 권리, 2,381 of 20,267 명세서 비고 and 154 of 29,275 최선순위 설정 matched a name pattern ("갑구 제14번 ○○○지분", "소유자 ○○○"), most of the 비고 hits being 공유 지분 words, not names. A name is a 2-4 syllable word right before one of `before`, or right after one of `after` where that word starts a word and is set off by a space, colon or bracket (with the names a comma joins to it), followed by a particle or the end; one of `not_names` (judged without a trailing particle) is not a name. A name is replaced by `mask`. A pattern-and-context recognizer as Microsoft Presidio's PatternRecognizer is; Bronze keeps the text as received. The Silver load (courtauction_go_kr.py mask_names) and its tests read this; nothing else restates it.

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load may take (plan-silver-load-objects): objects of each search that no commit of its table records, landed within window_days, oldest first, at most max_objects per table (a week of nights). The window stays shorter than the snapshot retention (lakehouse-maintenance.contract.json retain_days, refused otherwise): an expired snapshot takes its load record with it.

pnu_resolution.$comment: Root ADR-0382 (ADR-0288 §2 stage 3). The list rows carry the representative parcel's 10-digit legal-dong code in four fields (from_code.legal_dong_code_fields, widths 2+3+3+2) and its lot (from_code.lot_field); code + lot is the row's source PNU (source_code_pnu_raw), carried to the current code by place_identity_resolver.resolve, the code path every parcel source takes. Measured 2026-10-21 on a full list crawl (124,533 rows, read-only): 121,963 (97.9%) assemble; the rest are blank codes or prose lots. A row the code path leaves unresolved falls back to the address (ADR-0280 §4): the 행정구역 names (hjguSido, hjguSigu, hjguDong, hjguRd) with daepyoLotno as a jibun address, else rdNm with buldNo as a road address, through address_pnu.py, whose 시도 prefixes come from the 법정동 code table and its recorded pairs each load (root ADR-0403).
